mmlupro-baseline.description: Thinking off. Verified 2026-09-22 against llama-server --help on both boards: -rea is --reasoning, the thinking switch, NOT --reasoning-format. --reasoning-budget -1 is already llama.cpp's default; it is passed explicitly so the resolved command line records it.

mmlupro-thinking-on.description: The reasoning row. --reasoning-format MUST be pinned to none: left at its 'auto' default the thoughts go to message.reasoning_content, which lm-eval never reads, and answers arrive truncated or empty.

lg-baseline.description: S3, little-gemma thinking off: the -rea off counterpart. No <|think|> in the system turn (shim --thinking off) and engine -think -1, the --reasoning-budget -1 counterpart, passed explicitly so it is on the command line. -raw must be on, or the engine wraps the prompt in a second user turn. Context 8192 and the 2048 answer cap are compiled in; engine_build.txt in the run directory records the build.

lg-thinking-on.description: S3, little-gemma thinking on: the -rea on --reasoning-budget 320 counterpart. <|think|> in the system turn (shim --thinking on, byte-identical to llama-server's -rea on render) and engine -think 320, which force-closes the thought channel at 320 tokens. Thoughts come back inline, as --reasoning-format none returns them.

tq-baseline.description: S8, TurboQuant KV cache, thinking off: mmlupro-baseline's flags plus -ctk/-ctv turbo3, served by the pinned TurboQuant fork (engines/build_turboquant.sh, engine_build.txt in the run directory). Only the engine build and the KV type differ from S1. EFFECTIVE KV TYPES ARE K=q8_0, V=turbo3: the fork's auto-asymmetric rule upgrades K for Gemma 4's GQA 8:1 (n_head_kv=1), logged in server.log as 'upgrading K from turbo3 to q8_0'; TURBO_AUTO_ASYMMETRIC=0 would force turbo3 K. The command line still reads -ctk turbo3, which is what this fingerprint checks.

tq-thinking-on.description: S8t, TurboQuant KV cache, thinking on: mmlupro-thinking-on's flags (budget 320, --reasoning-format none) plus -ctk/-ctv turbo3. EFFECTIVE KV TYPES ARE K=q8_0, V=turbo3: the fork's auto-asymmetric rule upgrades K for Gemma 4's GQA 8:1 (n_head_kv=1), logged in server.log as 'upgrading K from turbo3 to q8_0'; TURBO_AUTO_ASYMMETRIC=0 would force turbo3 K. The command line still reads -ctk turbo3, which is what this fingerprint checks.

ae-base.description: S9 with every switch off: the proposed engine's binary must reproduce S3 by itself. The thinking-off task of lg-baseline, run through little-gemma-ae (ae.patch). -block is recorded but not asserted: the verify width is chosen per model.

ae-reuse.description: S9 -reuse: shared-prefix KV snapshots across requests; nothing else. The thinking-off task of lg-baseline, run through little-gemma-ae (ae.patch). -block is recorded but not asserted: the verify width is chosen per model.

ae-ngram.description: S9 -ngram: prompt-lookup drafts through the greedy verify; nothing else. The thinking-off task of lg-baseline, run through little-gemma-ae (ae.patch). -block is recorded but not asserted: the verify width is chosen per model.

ae-full.description: S9 -reuse -ngram: the proposed engine as a whole. No MTP head, as neither baseline ran speculative decoding. The thinking-off task of lg-baseline, run through little-gemma-ae (ae.patch). -block is recorded but not asserted: the verify width is chosen per model.

ngram-baseline.description: S10: mmlupro-baseline's flags plus llama.cpp's own n-gram speculative decoding (--spec-type ngram-simple). The lookup/draft sizes vary by cfg and are recorded, not asserted.
